messages.subject: geom_density with smoothly changing fill?
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to produce a geom_density plot where the fill colour would change smoothly from blue to white to red based on the x axis position.

An analogous operation works for geom_histogram (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/17732084/colours-for-geom-histogram) for instance with:
ggplot(mydata, aes(x=somevariable, fill=..x..)) + geom_histogram() + scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")

With geom_density, however, this does not work. 

> p <- ggplot(mydata, aes(x=somevariable, fill=..x..)) + geom_density() + scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")
Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) : 
  Aesthetics can not vary with a ribbon


Is there a way to induce smooth filling to geom_density?


br, L

messages.author: 848f474de6e0bc76
messages.subject: Re: geom_density with smoothly changing fill?
parts:
Thanks for the anonymous person who replied to me privately, I could solve the problem with the following:

DF <- as.data.frame(list(x = rnorm(1000)))
library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(DF, aes(x = x)) + geom_density()
dfp <- ggplot_build(p)$data[[1]]
delta <- diff(dfp$x)[1]

ggplot(dfp) +
   geom_segment(aes(x = x - delta/2, xend = x + delta/2,
                    y = ymin, yend = ymax, color = x)) +
   scale_color_gradient2()
